faq.q: What is an AI image to video tool?
faq.a: It is software that uses AI to turn a still picture into an engaging video. It adds motion, camera moves, transitions and even an AI voiceover, so your images come to life.

faq.q: How does a photo become a video?
faq.a: The AI reads the image you upload and uses generative models to add movement. You choose the motion style, add text on screen, and generate a script and voiceover, so a simple photo becomes a polished video in minutes.

faq.q: What do you gain by making video from a photo?
faq.a: You can make far more video with far less effort, skip most of the cost of a shoot, go from idea to finished clip in minutes, and get more value from every product photo you already have.

faq.q: Can I post these clips on social?
faq.a: Yes, it is one of the most common uses. Make eye-catching videos sized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and other apps, to grow your audience and your engagement.

faq.q: How can a store use this for product marketing?
faq.a: Make before-and-after reveals, product showcase videos, social video ads and listing videos for marketplaces like Amazon. It is a fast way to give shoppers more reasons to buy.

faq.q: Can I make explainers and tutorials?
faq.a: Yes. It works well for clear, consistent tutorials, feature explainers and internal training videos. The AI gives the same professional delivery every time, with no re-recording.

faq.q: Can I add a voiceover or an AI avatar?
faq.a: Yes. An AI script writer and AI voiceover are built in. You can also add an AI avatar to present and narrate your video for a more personal feel.

faq.q: Which aspect ratios can I pick?
faq.a: Pick the aspect ratio you need: 9:16 for TikTok, Reels and Stories, 1:1 for the feed, or 16:9 for YouTube. Your video is formatted for each platform automatically.

definition.title: What Is AI Image to Video?
paras: AI image to video turns a still product photo into a moving UGC-style clip. Shoppers see one action, and they can also hear a short script from an avatar.

AIVideosUGC can add a voiceover, captions and a track from the music library. You can edit in the built-in editor, voice the script in another language, and publish to TikTok or Meta, or download the file with no watermark.
